title: REPORT on the implementation of the Council Recommendation of 30 October 2020 on A Bridge to Jobs – Reinforcing the Youth Guarantee and replacing the Council Recommendation of 22 April 2013 on establishing a Youth Guarantee
part_text: Recommends the promotion of volunteering opportunities within RYG schemes and the creation of a European quality framework for volunteering; emphasises that volunteering has the potential to improve the skills and employability of NEETs and to accommodate vulnerable young people in a supportive and solidarity-focused environment; considers that the integration of volunteering opportunities into RYG schemes could be achieved by creating synergies with Erasmus+ and its European Solidarity Corps volunteering strand and by ensuring that young people engaged with, or seeking to engage with, RYG schemes are also aware of available volunteering opportunities funded under different schemes; takes the view that RYG providers from the volunteering sector should be supported by adequate resources for the delivery of volunteering opportunities and other RYG offers, ensuring that existing funds for employment and training opportunities are not reallocated;
